# Probe

> Probe is a self-hosted form builder (a Tally / Typeform alternative) running at https://probe.riftfi.com. It has two surfaces: **hosted forms** (themed pages at `/f/<slug>` built in a dashboard) and **endpoint forms** (a form-to-email/webhook backend: POST any HTML form or JSON to `/submit` with an access key). Everything is same-origin on one domain.

Base URL: `https://probe.riftfi.com` (replace with your instance's origin if different).

## Which surface to use

- You just need to **collect submissions from a site, script, or agent** → use an **endpoint form** + `POST /submit`. No API key needed at submit time, only the public `access_key`.
- You need a **hosted, themed form page** with typed fields, validation, analytics → use **hosted forms** via the tRPC API (needs an API key).
- You only need to **read results** → tRPC `responses.list` (API key) or the export URL.

## 1. Endpoint forms — `POST /submit` (no auth)

```
POST https://probe.riftfi.com/submit
Content-Type: application/json | application/x-www-form-urlencoded | multipart/form-data
```

Body fields:
- `access_key` (required) — the endpoint form's public key (from the dashboard or `endpoint.create`).
- `email` (optional) — submitter email; becomes Reply-To on the notification.
- `from_name` (optional) — submitter name.
- `subject` (optional) — overrides the email subject.
- `redirect` (optional) — absolute URL; responds `303` there. Its origin must be in the form's allowed origins.
- `botcheck` (optional) — honeypot; leave empty. A non-empty value is silently dropped with a fake 200.
- `h-captcha-response` / `g-recaptcha-response` / `cf-turnstile-response` — only if captcha is enabled on the form.
- Any other keys — stored as the submission payload (max 50 keys, 64 KB body). File parts are ignored.

Example (server-side / agent):
```bash
curl -X POST https://probe.riftfi.com/submit \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"access_key":"YOUR_ACCESS_KEY","name":"Ada","email":"ada@example.com","message":"Hello"}'
```

Responses: `200 {"success":true,"message":"Submission received"}`; `303` redirect; errors are `{"success":false,"code":"...","message":"..."}` with codes `INVALID_INPUT` (400), `TOO_MANY_FIELDS` (400), `INVALID_REDIRECT` (400), `INVALID_ACCESS_KEY` (401), `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` (403), `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413), `SPAM_REJECTED` (422), `RATE_LIMITED` (429).

Rules that commonly bite agents:
- **Origin allowlist.** Browser requests must come from an origin in the form's `allowedOrigins` (wildcards like `*.example.com` work). **Requests with no `Origin`/`Referer` (curl, servers, agents) are rejected with 403 unless the form has `endpointSettings.allowServerSide: true`.** Enable it with `endpoint.update`.
- **Verification.** A new key starts unverified. Submissions are still stored and visible in the dashboard, but notification emails and webhooks only fire after the recipient clicks the verification link. (If the instance has no email provider configured, the link is printed in the server logs.)
- **Webhooks.** If `endpointSettings.webhookUrl` is set, each verified submission is POSTed there as `{"formId","formTitle","payload"}` with header `X-Probe-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>`. The signing secret is `endpointSettings.webhookSigningSecret` from `endpoint.get`.

## 2. Authentication — API key (for everything except `/submit` and public reads)

Use a personal API key. A human creates it once in **Dashboard → Settings → API keys** (it is shown only once) and gives it to the agent. Keys start with `probe_`.

Send it on every request, either header works:
```
Authorization: Bearer probe_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
X-API-Key: probe_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

- The key acts as its owner: forms the agent creates appear in that user's dashboard.
- Keys don't expire; they stop working when revoked in Settings. Treat them like passwords.
- A missing or invalid key on a protected call returns tRPC error code `UNAUTHORIZED`.
- API keys can't create or revoke API keys (`apiKeys.create` / `apiKeys.revoke` need a dashboard session). `apiKeys.list` works.
- Fallback without a key: sign in with `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email` `{"email","password"}` (send `Origin: https://probe.riftfi.com`), keep the session cookie, and send it instead of the header.

## 3. tRPC over HTTP — `/trpc/<router>.<procedure>`

The API uses tRPC with the **superjson** transformer, so inputs and outputs are wrapped in `{"json": ...}`.

- **Query** (read): `GET /trpc/<proc>?input=<url-encoded {"json":{...}}>`
- **Mutation** (write): `POST /trpc/<proc>` with body `{"json":{...}}`
- **Success**: `{"result":{"data":{"json": <value>}}}`
- **Error**: `{"error":{"json":{"message":"...","data":{"code":"NOT_FOUND" | "UNAUTHORIZED" | "BAD_REQUEST" | "TOO_MANY_REQUESTS" | ...}}}}`. Resources you don't own return `NOT_FOUND`.

```bash
# Query example
curl -G https://probe.riftfi.com/trpc/forms.list \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'input={"json":{"limit":20}}'

# Mutation example
curl -X POST https://probe.riftfi.com/trpc/forms.publish \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"json":{"id":"<form-uuid>"}}'
```

### Recipe: create and publish a hosted form

All calls below send `-H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_API_KEY"`.


1. `themes.list` (query, no input, public) → pick a theme `id`.
2. `forms.create` (mutation) `{"title":"Feedback","themeId":"<uuid>","visibility":"unlisted","description":"optional","slug":"optional-custom-slug"}` → returns the form (with `id`, `slug`).
3. `fields.create` (mutation), once per field, with increasing `order`:
   `{"formId":"<uuid>","type":"short_text","label":"Your name","required":true,"order":0,"config":{}}`
   Select-type example: `{"formId":"<uuid>","type":"single_select","label":"Plan","order":1,"config":{"options":[{"label":"Free","value":"free"},{"label":"Pro","value":"pro"}]}}`
4. `forms.publish` (mutation) `{"id":"<uuid>"}`.
5. Share `https://probe.riftfi.com/f/<slug>`.

Field `type` values: `short_text`, `long_text`, `email`, `number`, `single_select`, `multi_select`, `checkbox`, `rating`, `date`, `phone`, `url`, `linear_scale`, `ranking`, `address`, `time`, `signature`, `file_upload` (only if storage is configured), `page_break`.
Useful `config` keys: `options[{label,value}]`, `maxRating`, `ratingStyle` (`star|number|emoji`), `min`, `max`, `step`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `scaleMin`, `scaleMax`, `scaleMinLabel`, `scaleMaxLabel`, `hidden`, `prefillKey`. Unknown config keys are rejected.
Conditional display: `"conditionalLogic":{"showIf":[{"fieldId":"<uuid>","operator":"equals|not_equals|contains|is_filled|is_empty","value":"..."}]}` (all rules must pass).

### Recipe: let AI draft the form

If `ai.status` reports `hasKey: true`, one call creates a full draft (title + fields) from plain words:
`ai.generateForm` (mutation) `{"prompt":"A feedback form with a 1-5 rating, what they liked, and an optional email","themeId":"<uuid>"}` → `{id, slug, fieldCount}`. Review or tweak fields with `fields.*`, then `forms.publish`.

### Recipe: submit to a hosted form (public, no auth)

1. `public.getForm` (query) `{"slug":"<slug>"}` → `{form, fields, theme}`; field ids are the answer keys.
2. `public.submitResponse` (mutation) `{"slug":"<slug>","values":{"<fieldId>":"answer", ...},"submitterEmail":"optional"}`.
   Password-protected forms also need `"password"`. Rate-limited per IP per form.

### Recipe: create an endpoint form

1. `endpoint.create` (mutation) `{"title":"Contact","websiteUrl":"https://example.com","recipientEmail":"optional@example.com"}` → includes `accessKey`.
2. Optional, `endpoint.update` (mutation) `{"id":"<uuid>","allowedOrigins":["https://example.com"],"endpointSettings":{"allowServerSide":true,"webhookUrl":"https://hooks.example.com/probe"}}`.
3. Submit with `POST /submit` (section 1).

### Reading results

- `responses.list` (query) `{"formId":"<uuid>","limit":25,"from":"<ISO datetime>","to":"<ISO datetime>"}` → `{items:[...]}`. Hosted-form answers are in `items[].values[]` (`fieldId`, `value`). Endpoint submissions are in `items[].payload`.
- `responses.get` (query) `{"id":"<response-uuid>"}`.
- `forms.getAnalytics` (query) `{"id":"<form-uuid>"}` → views, starts, completion rate, daily series.
- File export (API key or session): `GET /forms/<formId>/export.csv` (also `.xlsx`, `.pdf`), e.g. `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROBE_API_KEY" -o out.csv https://probe.riftfi.com/forms/<formId>/export.csv`.

### Procedure index

- `public` (no auth): `getForm`, `submitResponse`, `trackEvent`, `listPublicForms`
- `themes` (no auth): `list`
- `auth`: `me`, `status`
- `apiKeys`: `list` (create/revoke require a dashboard session)
- `forms`: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `publish`, `unpublish`, `duplicate`, `setPassword`, `getAnalytics`, `fieldDistribution`
- `fields`: `list` `{formId}`, `create`, `update`, `delete` `{id}`, `reorder` `{formId, fields:[{id,order}]}`
- `responses`: `list`, `get`, `delete`, `exportCsv`
- `endpoint`: `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `rotateKey`, `resendVerification`, `delete`, `auditLog`
- `integrations`: Discord and Google Sheets forwarding per form (`listForForm`, `upsertForForm`, `deleteForForm`)
- `ai`: `status`, `generateForm` `{"prompt":"describe the form","themeId":"<uuid>"}` → `{id, slug, fieldCount}` (needs an AI provider connected in Settings, or an instance default)
- `admin` (admin role only): `getStats`, `listForms`, `listUsers`, `setFormStatus`, `setFormVisibility`, `deleteForm`, `setUserRole`
